results.rawContent: Introducing Anderson’s Conn Valley Vineyards Anderson’s Conn Valley Vineyards was founded in 1983 by Gus and Todd Anderson and released their first commercial wine with the 1987 vintage. The 1988 vintage Cabernet graced the cover of the Wine Spectator magazine, and it has remained a classic, traditional and sought after Napa Valley icon ever since. The estate is 40 acres with 25 acres planted to several different Cabernet clones including the Eisele, Jordan, Bonny’s and 337 types. Never producing more than six thousand cases a year, the winery has maintained an exclusive relationship with its club subscribers and select retailers for three decades. Current releases range from an estate grown Cabernet Sauvignon, to the classic Right Bank (92pts Vinous), Estate Reserve Cabernet (94pts Dunnuck), “Eloge” Proprietary blend (93+pts Dunnuck), and the rare Signature Cabernet (95pts Parker) and “Aurum” Red (97pts Wine Enthusiast.) 1832 Second St., Suite N, Berkeley, CA 94710 | 510-486-8347 | AuthenticWS.com Introducing Philippe & Sylvain Ravier (AWS Direct Import) Philippe and Sylvain Ravier cultivate 35 hectares of vines in the Savoie appellations of Apremont, Abymes, Chignin and Saint Jean de la Porte. The Ravier vineyards are situated on the slopes along the broad valley that runs from Albertville to Chambery along the banks of the Isere River, known as the Combe de Savoie. The Chignin-Bergeron vineyards are on the south-facing slopes of the Massif des Bauges. The adjacent crus of Apremont and Abymes are located on the slopes created by the catastrophic landslide of the north face of Mont Granier that occurred in 1248, burying the existing villages and their inhabitants. That event reshaped the landscape, creating the Lac St. Andre, hillsides and amphitheaters with limestone scree soils that would later become prized vineyards. Philippe and Sylvain Ravier cultivate 7 hectares of Roussanne (locally known as Bergeron) vines in the commune of Chignin. The vines are between 10 and 30 years of age and are planted on very steep, due south-facing slopes of the Massif des Bauges at 350-450 meters of altitude. The soil is rocky, decomposed white limestone which drains well while retaining heat. The fruit is harvested by hand, carefully sorted and moved into the press by gravity. After a light pressing, the must is protected from oxidization by a blanket of CO2. The must is then cooled and lightly clarified (débourbage). Fermentation lasts for about 1 month after which the wine develops on its lees for about 4 months. Malolactic fermentation takes place over the winter. At the end of the fermentation period, the lees are circulated in the tank as the Chignin-Bergeron matures in tank for 9 months. It is fined with Bentonite clay and filtered just before bottling in the Spring. Ravier’s Chignin-Bergeron is the richest and most powerful of their Savoie whites, with aromas and flavors of honey, quince and apricots, an almost viscous texture that is balanced by a fresh and minerally finish. The domaine’s second largest holding of Jacquère vines is in Apremont where they cultivate 6 hectares. The vines are between 10 and 60 years of age and are planted on east and south-east facing slopes of the Mont Grenier at 250-350 meters of altitude. A thin layer of top soil covers decomposed white limestone, often still in large blocks and some marl (a mix of limestone and clay). This combination assures good drainage while retaining heat. The Raviers plant grass in every second row and work the other rows mechanically to aerate the soil and remove the grass. The fruit is carefully sorted and moved into the press by gravity. After a light pressing, the must is protected from oxidization by a blanket of CO2. The must is then cooled and lightly clarified (débourbage). Fermentation lasts for about 1 month after which the wine develops on its lees for about 4 months. The lees are gently circulated in the tank to enhance complexity. The wine is fined with Bentonite clay and filtered just before bottling in January. The Ravier Apremont’s vigorous and expressive bouquet of white flowers, stones and citrus follow through on palate, leading to a fresh, pure and precise finish.
